record.question: Drug Susceptibility Test (DST) for tubercle bacilli is done by these methods, EXCEPT:
record.explanation: Official final key: D — HPLC. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 6, printed Q90. Source limitation: More than one listed method is used in TB drug-susceptibility testing: proportion/MGIT phenotypic methods, molecular DNA microarray tests, and HPLC-based mycolic-acid susceptibility assays are all documented. The “EXCEPT” item has no uniquely correct option. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
